titles: Issue to everyone in one click
captions: Still making certificates by hand, and answering emails asking if they're real?
With Sert trust, you design your certificate once.
Upload your list, and issue to everyone in one click.
Each person gets a secure link to their own certificate.
Anyone can check that it's genuine, instantly.
And it goes straight onto their LinkedIn profile.
Sert trust. Trusted digital certificates, issued in minutes. Get started at sert trust dot app.
